CENT = ARE × 2.4710, as the sheet computes it
BLACK = absolutely certain — traced or read from the original sheet
RED = unavailable, unidentified, or definitely wrong
1. The label reading “219/6, 1.90 are” has no basis in this plat. 219/6 belongs to the seven children of Kunjipennu and is not part of O.S. 197/1983. The 5/6 allotment sums to 29.42 only if
that slot is 219/19 · 4.75 are, which the original legend lists in that position. Flagged on the sketch, not silently relabelled — the parcel the arrow points to could not be verified.
2. PLOT-LETTER CONFLICT. Final Decree para (2) describes the 1/6 allotment (5.88 are / 14.524 cent) as the plot marked H I J K L M, comprised in Re.Sy. 219/29. The legend on this sheet lists
H, I, J, K, L, M against the whole 35.30-are parent block and puts 219/29 (0.65 are) inside the 5/6. Every extent agrees — only the corner string and the survey number recited differ.
Read Ext. C1(a) itself before relying on any plot-letter string, and treat the decree’s single survey number per plot as shorthand for the itemised legend.
3. TITLE GAP. Deed 299/I/2024 conveyed 13/15 undivided shares only. 2/15 (3.923 are / 9.693 cent) stands outside the Trust — Manoj Ravindran and Anand Ravindran, two of the three heirs
of the late Dr. M. Ravindran, did not execute it. O.S. 243/2024 nevertheless pleads the whole 38.06 ares as belonging to the Trust. Verify against the certified deed before use.
GREEN = station corners and bordering plots

text.tspan: !! Effected pendente lite, while O.S. 214/2025 and IA 6/2026 are live. Applicant, date and instrument are stated in the Village Office
mutation file on TP 17644, which has not been obtained. Nothing beyond the fact of the register change is asserted here.
!! SOURCE RESOLUTION. The photocopy PDF holds one raster of 901 x 1418 px for the whole sheet; the drawn block is 324 x 327 px.
The perimeter dimensions read; the annotation inside 219/11 and 219/19 is below the resolution floor and cannot be recovered from this file.
!! The two agree to 1.4%. THE DIMENSIONS ARE IN METRES, NOT FEET. The "ft" on every dimension and in the legend of the
source sheet is wrong. Read as feet the parcels come out ten times too small. The sheet IS drawn to scale.
!! Two consequences. 219/11 is drawn as TWO polygons whose union is 22.49 are against 21.81 recorded (+3%).
Key 5, not the east half, is therefore 219/11-1 — which contradicts the "edge signature diff 0.0" note, whose
reference file was named 219-11.svg. Resolve against Ext. C1(a); nothing here is asserted as settled.
